summary: AudioEye, Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 7.01, 8.01, 9.01) on October 20, 2026, disclosing that its Board of Directors approved a new share repurchase program authorizing up to $15.0 million of common stock, expiring October 18, 2027. The new authorization replaces and terminates the January 2025 program that was scheduled to expire January 24, 2027. Repurchases may occur via open market, block, privately negotiated transactions, accelerated share repurchase programs, or Rule 10b5-1 plans, funded from working capital and cash from operations. No price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. Watch actual buyback pace versus cash generation and any anti-takeover signaling.
